title.zh: 特朗普国情咨文后两周内支持率能否回升至45%以上？
title.en: Will Trump's approval rating rise above 45% within two weeks of his State of the Union address?

yes.zh: 主流民调在国情咨文后两周内显示特朗普支持率达到或超过45%
yes.en: Major polls show Trump approval at or above 45% within two weeks of the State of the Union

no.zh: 支持率未能在两周内升至45%
no.en: Approval fails to reach 45% within two weeks

title.zh: 最高法院推翻特朗普关税后，能否在60天内通过其他工具实现等效关税？
title.en: After the Supreme Court ruling, will equivalent tariffs be reimposed via other tools within 60 days?

yes.zh: 裁决后60天内，美国通过其他合法权限（如232条款、301条款或紧急经济权力法）实施平均税率等效的全局关税措施
yes.en: Within 60 days of the ruling, the U.S. imposes a global tariff regime with an average rate equivalent to the struck-down tariffs via other legal authority (e.g., 232/301/IEEPA)

no.en: No equivalent tariff regime is implemented within 60 days

title.zh: 加沙停火协议能否维持至2026年3月底？
title.en: Will the Gaza ceasefire remain intact through March 2026?

yes.zh: 至2026年3月31日，未有官方宣布停火破裂且无为期48小时以上的大规模军事行动重启
yes.en: Through Mar 31, 2026, no formal termination of ceasefire and no resumption of large-scale hostilities lasting 48+ hours

no.zh: 3月底前停火正式破裂或发生48小时以上的大规模交战
no.en: Ceasefire formally collapses or 48+ hours of large-scale hostilities occur before Mar 31

title.zh: 美国支持的委内瑞拉行动能否在2026年内导致马杜罗下台？
title.en: Will the US-backed operation in Venezuela result in Maduro leaving power in 2026?

yes.zh: 尼古拉斯·马杜罗于2026年12月31日前正式不再担任委内瑞拉总统（辞职、罢免或确认选举落败）
yes.en: Nicolas Maduro ceases to be Venezuela's president before Dec 31, 2026 (resignation, removal, or confirmed electoral defeat)

no.en: Maduro remains in office through year-end

title.zh: 伊朗能否在30天内释放被拘押的日本公民？
title.en: Will Iran release the detained Japanese national within 30 days?

yes.zh: 2026年3月27日前，伊朗当局正式释放该日本公民并允许其离境或与外交人员会合
yes.en: By Mar 27, 2026, Iranian authorities formally release the Japanese national, allowing departure or consular handover

title.zh: 基尔·斯塔默能否在2026年5月地方选举后仍保住首相职位？
title.en: Will Keir Starmer remain Prime Minister after the May 2026 UK local elections?

yes.zh: 2026年6月1日前，基尔·斯塔默仍为在任首相
yes.en: By Jun 1, 2026, Keir Starmer remains incumbent PM

no.zh: 地方选举后辞职或被迫下台
no.en: He resigns or is ousted following local elections

title.zh: 2026年美国中期选举，民主党能否夺回众议院？
title.en: Will Democrats retake the House in the 2026 US midterms?

yes.zh: 民主党在2026年11月选举后控制众议院多数
yes.en: Democrats control a House majority after the November 2026 elections

no.zh: 共和党保住众议院多数

title.zh: 德国新政府能否在2026年4月前完成组阁？
title.en: Will Germany form a new coalition government before April 2026?

yes.zh: 2026年4月1日前，新一届联合政府宣誓就职
yes.en: New coalition government is sworn in before Apr 1, 2026

title.zh: 2026年法国议会选举，国民联盟能否赢得多数？
title.en: Will France's National Rally win a parliamentary majority in 2026?

yes.zh: 国民联盟赢得>289席，获得多数
yes.en: >289 seats for National Rally (absolute majority)

title.zh: 最高院裁决后，美国Q2关税收入是否较Q1均值下滑≥20%？
title.en: After the court ruling, will U.S. tariff receipts in Q2 fall ≥20% vs Q1 average?

yes.zh: 美国海关与边境保护局公布的2026年Q2月度平均关税收入较Q1月均值下降至少20%
yes.en: CBP-reported average monthly tariff receipts in Q2 2026 are at least 20% lower than Q1 average

title.zh: 1,400+进口商关税退税案能否在2026年内迎来首个原告胜诉判决？
title.en: Will the tariff refund cases by 1,400+ importers see a first plaintiff victory in 2026?

yes.zh: 2026年12月31日前，合并审理或相关案件中至少一例出现一审或终审支持原告的书面判决
yes.en: By Dec 31, 2026, at least one written ruling (trial or final) in consolidated/related cases rules for plaintiffs

no.zh: 年内无任何原告胜诉判决

title.zh: 美联储3月会议是否降息25个基点？
title.en: Will the Fed cut by 25bps at its March 2026 meeting?

yes.zh: FOMC在3月会议宣布降息25bp
yes.en: FOMC announces a 25bps rate cut in March

title.zh: 欧洲央行3月是否再度降息25个基点？
title.en: Will the ECB cut rates by another 25bps in March 2026?

yes.zh: 管委会3月会议宣布降息25bp
yes.en: ECB Governing Council announces a 25bps cut in March

no.zh: 不降息或采取其他行动

title.zh: 黄金价格能否在Q1 2026突破3000美元/盎司？
title.en: Will gold break $3,000/oz in Q1 2026?

yes.zh: 伦敦现货金在2026年3月31日前任意时刻≥$3,000/oz
yes.en: London spot gold reaches ≥$3,000/oz at any point before Mar 31, 2026

title.zh: 英国2026年2月CPI能否低于2.5%？
title.en: Will UK CPI for Feb 2026 come in below 2.5%?

yes.zh: 英国统计局公布的2026年2月CPI年率<2.5%
yes.en: ONS reports Feb 2026 CPI YoY below 2.5%

title.zh: 韩国2026年入境游客能否达到≥1500万人？
title.en: Will South Korea reach ≥15 million foreign visitors in 2026?

yes.zh: 韩国官方统计显示2026年全年入境游客数≥1500万
yes.en: Official stats show ≥15M inbound visitors for 2026

title.zh: 沙特能否在2026年6月底前解除≥20个国家的家禽进口禁令？
title.en: Will Saudi Arabia lift poultry import bans on ≥20 countries by end of June 2026?

yes.zh: 官方公告显示至2026-06-30已对至少20个国家解除家禽/鸡蛋禁令
yes.en: By Jun 30, 2026, official notices show bans lifted for at least 20 countries

no.en: Fewer than 20 countries see bans lifted

title.zh: 比特币能否在3月底前触及$100,000？
title.en: Will Bitcoin hit $100,000 before the end of March 2026?

yes.zh: 任一主流交易平台现货价在2026-03-31前任意时刻≥$100,000
yes.en: On any major spot venue, BTC reaches ≥$100,000 before Mar 31, 2026

title.zh: 以太坊价格能否在2026年内重返$4,000？
title.en: Will Ethereum trade at or above $4,000 at any point in 2026?

yes.zh: ETH现货价在2026-12-31前任意时刻≥$4,000
yes.en: ETH spot price reaches ≥$4,000 before Dec 31, 2026

title.zh: 美国SEC能否在2026年内批准以太坊“质押型”ETF？
title.en: Will the US SEC approve an Ethereum ETF with staking in 2026?

yes.zh: 2026-12-31前，SEC批准至少一只包含原生质押收益的ETH现货ETF
yes.en: By Dec 31, 2026, SEC approves at least one ETH spot ETF permitting staking yield

title.zh: Solana能否在Q1 2026触及$400？
title.en: Will Solana reach $400 in Q1 2026?

yes.zh: SOL现货价在2026-03-31前任意时刻≥$400
yes.en: SOL spot price reaches ≥$400 before Mar 31, 2026

title.zh: 美国能否在2026年内通过联邦稳定币监管法案？
title.en: Will the US enact a federal stablecoin regulation law in 2026?

yes.zh: 两院通过并由总统签署生效的联邦稳定币法在2026年内完成
yes.en: Both chambers pass and the President signs a federal stablecoin law in 2026

title.zh: OpenAI能否在2026年内完成IPO？
title.en: Will OpenAI complete an IPO in 2026?

yes.zh: OpenAI于2026-12-31前在主要交易所挂牌上市
yes.en: OpenAI lists on a major exchange before Dec 31, 2026

title.zh: 英伟达市值能否在2026年任一交易日收盘≥$4万亿？
title.en: Will Nvidia's market cap close at or above $4T on any day in 2026?

yes.zh: 官方收市数据在2026年任意一日显示NVDA市值≥$4T
yes.en: Official close shows NVDA market cap ≥$4T on any trading day in 2026

title.zh: 欧盟AI法案能否在2026年内全面生效？
title.en: Will the EU AI Act come fully into force in 2026?

yes.zh: 核心条款在2026-12-31前对受监管AI系统全面适用
yes.en: Core provisions apply to regulated AI systems by Dec 31, 2026

no.zh: 关键条款推迟至2027或更晚

title.zh: Apple Intelligence能否在Q2 2026正式推出中文版？
title.en: Will Apple Intelligence launch with Mandarin support in Q2 2026?

yes.zh: 2026-06-30前，苹果正式发布支持普通话的Apple Intelligence功能
yes.en: By Jun 30, 2026, Apple officially launches Mandarin-supported Apple Intelligence

no.en: No official Mandarin launch in Q2

title.zh: 2026年世界杯，墨西哥能否闯入四强？
title.en: Will Mexico reach the semi-finals at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?

yes.zh: 墨西哥国家队晋级世界杯四强
yes.en: Mexico national team reaches the last four

title.zh: 利物浦能否在2025-26赛季英超最终夺冠？
title.en: Will Liverpool win the 2025-26 Premier League title?

yes.zh: 利物浦赢得英超冠军
yes.en: Liverpool win the Premier League

title.zh: 2026年六国赛，爱尔兰能否夺冠？
title.en: Will Ireland win the 2026 Six Nations Championship?

yes.zh: 爱尔兰获得六国锦标赛总冠军（含并列冠军视为夺冠）
yes.en: Ireland finish champions (shared title counts)

no.en: Ireland do not win the title

title.zh: 2026年奥斯卡最佳影片，非英语片能否获奖？
title.en: Will a non-English language film win Best Picture at the 2026 Oscars?

yes.zh: 2026年奥斯卡最佳影片由主要对白为非英语的电影获奖
yes.en: Best Picture is awarded to a film with primarily non-English dialogue
